newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel to aim for 129.10 short term.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel to aim for 129.10 short term.

text.p: MATIF September notionnel futures have the potential to climb back to 129.10 on Monday after mustering strength from nearby support last week, analysts said.
Nicholas Rose, technical analyst at 4CAST in London, said gap support in the 129.44-40 range hit on Friday was enough to trigger a rally.
"A short rally today will be in order," he said, pegging resistance at 128.90 -- a break point on Thursday and near to 128.84 which is a 38.2 percent retracement of last week's fall.
The top of a corrective rally should conclude at 129.10, he said. By 0745 GMT, September notionnel were 0.10 up at 128.72.
Rose said an important support was 128.62, which is a congestion level on Friday. "If that breaks, it should settle back at 128.55/50 area," Rose said.
The market was likely to shift to forward gear after testing support and a major decline was unlikely, he added.
Lynn Branigan, technical analyst at MCM YieldWatch in London, also saw gains limited to to 129.10 for now, with initial resistance at 128.82,the session high so far on Monday.
He said a breach of 128.66, a 38 percent retracement of the rise from the 128.42 low on Friday to 128.82, suggested further losses to 128.56 and then to 128.42.
Intermediate support at 128.56 is a 62 percent retracement of the rise from 128.42 to 128.82, analysts said.
September PIBOR futures were quoted one basis point higher at 96.54.
